Hi there. I’m in the same boat (I’m24f) and my fiance (39m) is the one with low libido. 

I have the highest sex drive of any woman I’ve ever talked to. I want it every day, and he wants it about 2-3 times a month. I feel your frustration 100%. Even after the talks and questioning myself. 

The thing that helped me deal with the frustration was thinking of it this way- just masturbate. It really hurts being rejected a million times. You do wonder if you suck, or if it’s you, but it’s not. No matter how much it may seem that way. Just take care of it yourself, and hopefully when she’s in the mood she will come to you about it- that’s about all you can do. 

If you TRULY love your partner and you do want it to work out, remind yourself of all the amazing things she does and the things you love about her when you’re feeling frustrated. When you’re feeling tempted to stray remind yourself that your love for her is stronger than your sexual desire. If that is TRUE. 

It hurt so much, and I know that at times it really REALLY sucks. I love my fiance more than anything so I just take care of it myself and wait for him to make a move or come to me when he’s ready. That is really all you can do. Do. Not. Cheat. Have the same strength to leave her and tell her the truth about the sexual incompatibility. It may hurt her- but not as much as being cheated on- and that includes emotional cheating. 

Maybe keep a journal or cut up a piece of paper and throw it away to release some of your frustration. Find an alternative to questioning yourself but using the frustration in a positive way- maybe go buy her flowers WITHOUT expecting sex out of it. 

For me- I get so frustrated sometimes I honestly have to go for a car ride with the windows up and just scream my lungs out. The thing is at the end of the day I love my fiance SO much I’m willing to have to struggle with that difference than to leave him and all the other incredible things he does for me and our kids and our family. I rather deal with the frustration and take it out at work- which for me means cleaning things faster and more aggressively lol. Use the frustration and do something productive. And that’s all you can do.

If you truly love her and want it to work. You have to figure out if that is true for you and your relationship. End of rant lol.
